name: Toronto Blue Jays
description: WestJet's 737 MAX 8 C-GORP (fleet 386) co-branded with the Toronto Blue Jays for the team's 50th season and WestJet's 30th: WestJet's white forward with its standard navy 'WESTJET' title over the forward windows and the teal under the engines; the Jays' royal blue covering the rear fuselage, from the fin's root sweeping down and forward to the belly under the wing (its front edge hidden by the wing in the press photo), the sweep meant to show an aircraft taking off and the arc of a ball off the bat; the fin royal blue with the Blue Jays' logo (the jay's white and blue head with the red maple leaf) in its middle.

sources.title: WestJet news release: From runway to home run, WestJet unveils Toronto Blue Jays co-branded aircraft (2026-06-23)
sources.note: Unveiled 2026-06-23 at the YYZ hangar on tail #386, a 737 MAX 8; first flight 2026-06-24.

sources.title: World Airline News: WestJet introduces a Toronto Blue Jays logo jet on C-GORP (2026-06-23)
sources.note: Names the registration, C-GORP (ex-Swoop, with WestJet since October 2023).

sources.title: AirlineGeeks: WestJet unveils new Blue Jays livery (2026-06-25)
sources.note: White with the Jays' royal blue; the Jays' logo on the vertical stabilizer.

sources.title: WestJet news release photo: C-GORP in the YYZ hangar at the unveiling, right side (airline press photo, via PR Newswire, 2026-06-23)
sources.note: Right side three-quarter view from near the wing tip with a wide-angle lens (also on westjet.com's own release page, tbj.png). Measured only, never copied or shipped: the blue's sweep from the fin root to the belly by the main gear, the blue fin, winglets and logo, the teal under the cowling. Perspective (nose near, tail far) makes shares approximate, within about 0.03.

logos.description: The Toronto Blue Jays' logo across the fin's middle: the jay's head in white and blues, its beak toward the tail on the right side (the same picture both sides), a red maple leaf over the back of its head (the team's mark, carried for its partner: drawn in Skyarium as our own simplified mark, WJA/blue-jays).
The same logo on the right face, placed for its own fit: the leaf toward the leading edge there, so a little lower and back to keep clear of it, as in the press photo.
The small Canadian flag behind the forward door, 'Proudly' above it, as on WestJet's standard.

notes: Drawn 2026-11-23 from the airline press photo only, at low confidence: the perspective and the wing over the blue's front edge leave its curve approximate (front at the belly about x 0.53, at the crown at the fin's root about 0.775). Title and flag as WestJet's standard. Redraw from a side-on open photo when one appears.

areas.name: the Jays' royal blue: the rear fuselage, its front edge sweeping from the fin's root down and forward to the belly by the main gear (the arc of a ball off the bat)
teal along the cowling's lower edge

titles.style: WestJet's wordmark: heavy, slanted, slab-like capitals in navy over the forward windows, the J dropping below the line.
